fidelityToBalancerV3Exit.verdict: APPROXIMATE - no minimum-supply reserve or check; differences are dust-scale (ASSUMED)

fidelityToBalancerV3Exit.mock: the vault's raw ERC20 balanceOf - any token sent directly to the mock vault inflates every exit and getPoolTokenInfo
fidelityToBalancerV3Exit.mainnet: per-pool accounted balances inside a commingled Vault; direct transfers to the Vault do not change a pool's balances

fidelityToBalancerV3Exit.mock: one flag: paused => proportional reverts AND recovery allowed; unpaused => recovery reverts
fidelityToBalancerV3Exit.mainnet: independent states: recovery exit works whenever Recovery Mode is enabled (paused or not); proportional exit works whenever the pool/vault is not paused (even in Recovery Mode); paused pool requires someone to call permissionless enableRecoveryMode before recovery exits work
fidelityToBalancerV3Exit.verdict: UNFAITHFUL - conflates the two; cannot model 'paused but recovery not yet enabled' (both exits revert on mainnet) or 'recovery enabled while unpaused'
